cases.sentence: На третий месяц после ухода из ___ израилетяне достигли Синайской пустыни.
cases.translation: In the third month after leaving Egypt the Israelites reached the wilderness of Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: A thick cloud stood over the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition над governs the instrumental case.
The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я приду к тебе в густом ___.
cases.translation: I will come to you in a thick cloud.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.
The transitive verb выстирать takes a direct object in the accusative.

cases.translation: The Lord came down onto the top of Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating motion toward a goal takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The Lord descended on it in fire.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating a state or medium takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Моисей вывел народ из ___ навстречу Богу.
cases.translation: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: На третий месяц после ухода из Египта, в этот же день, израилетяне достигли Синайской пустыни.
reading.question: When did the Israelites reach the wilderness of Sinai?
options: In the third month after leaving Egypt
On the very day they left Egypt
In the first month of the year
reading.correct: In the third month after leaving Egypt
reading.explain: The text says it was 'На третий месяц после ухода из Египта' (in the third month after leaving Egypt).

reading.ru: Народ ответил единогласно, «Мы исполним все, что сказал Господь».
reading.question: How did the people respond to the Lord's words?
options: Unanimously, promising to do all the Lord said
reading.correct: Unanimously, promising to do all the Lord said
reading.explain: The text says the people answered 'единогласно' that 'Мы исполним все, что сказал Господь' (we will do all that the Lord has said).

reading.ru: Господь сказал Моисею, «Пойди к народу и освяти его сегодня и завтра.
reading.question: What did the Lord tell Moses to do with the people?
reading.explain: The Lord told Moses to 'освяти его сегодня и завтра' (sanctify them today and tomorrow).

reading.ru: Утром третьего дня были гром и молния, густое облако над горой и громовой звук рога.
reading.question: What happened on the morning of the third day?
options: Thunder, lightning, a thick cloud, and a loud trumpet
The people set out to march
reading.correct: Thunder, lightning, a thick cloud, and a loud trumpet
reading.explain: The text lists 'гром и молния, густое облако над горой и громовой звук рога' (thunder and lightning, a thick cloud, and a loud trumpet sound).

reading.ru: Гора Синай была застлана дымом, потому что Господь сошел на нее в огне.
reading.question: Why was Mount Sinai covered in smoke?
options: Because the Lord descended on it in fire
reading.correct: Because the Lord descended on it in fire
reading.explain: The text says it was covered in smoke 'потому что Господь сошел на нее в огне' (because the Lord came down on it in fire).

reading.ru: Моисей говорил, и Бог отвечал ему громовым голосом.
reading.question: How did God answer Moses?
reading.explain: The text says God answered him 'громовым голосом' (with a voice of thunder).
